Musick's local AAC-LC fallback uses Project Symphonia 0.6.1, distributed under
the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (MPL-2.0). The bundled WebAssembly module is
built from codec/Cargo.toml and codec/src/lib.rs with codec/Cargo.lock.

Symphonia source and license:
https://github.com/pdeljanov/Symphonia/tree/v0.6.1
https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/MPL/2.0/

The AAC decoder was ported and relicensed from NihAV with permission from
Kostya Shishkov. See the upstream Symphonia AAC decoder README for attribution.

The pinned WebAssembly build also incorporates the Rust crates listed in
codec/Cargo.lock. Their declared licenses are MPL-2.0 for Symphonia crates,
Apache-2.0 OR MIT for autocfg, bitflags, lazy_static, log, num-complex,
num-traits, regex-lite, and smallvec, and Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT for
bytemuck. Copies of the Apache-2.0, MIT, and Zlib license texts for the
permissively licensed dependencies are in vendor/licenses/.

The Musick wrapper code in codec/src/lib.rs is licensed under Musick's MIT
license. The Symphonia dependency remains MPL-2.0; see the license text in
symphonia-LICENSE.txt and the pinned dependency versions in codec/Cargo.lock.
